tasks.short: Analyze air and water samples for contaminants

steps.what: Check samples, identities and the applicable analytical method
Prepare and analyze samples using the selected method
outputs: raw readings with sample, method and quality-control provenance

steps.what: Calculate specified contaminant results from checked analytical readings
inputs: raw readings with sample, method and quality-control provenance
outputs: calculated results with units and calculation version

steps.what: Assess analytical validity and resolve unexpected contaminant results
inputs: calculated results with units and calculation version
raw readings with sample, method and quality-control provenance

steps.what: Enter the assessed results in the existing analytical record

tasks.design: Use tested method-specific calculations in the existing laboratory {OPS_SYSTEM}, then native sample-linked record fields. Retain sample preparation, measurements, validity assessment and the technician's final result entry.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated spreadsheet calculations and sample headings can sit beside physical analytical work.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit method formulas and native sample identifiers permit repeatable calculation and limited entry reuse.
tasks.still_hard: Contamination, measurement limitations and questionable quality controls require technical investigation.
tasks.human_edge: Decide whether an apparent result is analytically credible.
tasks.altitude: Keep analysis credible while making routine arithmetic reproducible.

reach.learn: Keep raw readings and method versions attached to calculated values.

evidence.claim: SampleManager supports sample tracking and test assignment; this supports sample identity capability, not measured nuclear analysis savings.
Tested method formulas could reduce repeated arithmetic; this task's benefit is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: OPS_SYSTEM is the existing laboratory information and analytical software. The baseline includes the actual analytical record used to retain and interpret sample results, not a new activity log.

Sampling staff produce sample identifiers and collection provenance in current sampling work; s1 checks these. The technician produces readings, units, method identifier and quality-control context in s2, retaining all capture and physical work. The controlled method supplies formulas; missing metadata require manual resolution before s3.
Native calculation settings and record fields are tried first. Only arithmetic currently performed manually is eligible; existing instrument runtime supplies no saving.
The record template removes 1 hour of repeated sample headings, retaining individual result entry, checking and the author's ordinary ungated save.
unknowns: Which calculations are already performed by instruments.
Whether records already reuse sample identity.
research_questions: Replay routine and failed-control samples against existing calculations and measure correction time.

incremental.description: Maintain method formula tests and record fields

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=84, gross 16 minus 2 upkeep gives central net 14. Conservative case: method incompatibility retains 13/15 calculation hours and all 10 record hours plus 75 fixed hours: 98 retained, 2 gross minus 2 =0. Compatible validated formulas retain 6 calculation hours and 9 record hours plus 75 fixed: 90 retained, 10 gross minus 2 =8.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend radioactive decontamination procedures for the equipment and contamination

steps.what: Assess equipment characteristics and contamination measurements
Find current decontamination procedures and equipment-specific limitations
Determine the appropriate procedure and restrictions for this case
Write the procedure recommendation used by the responsible work team
Communicate the recommendation and restrictions to the responsible colleagues

tasks.design: Configure a controlled {DOCS} procedure view and reference headings for the existing recommendation. The technician retains contamination assessment, procedure choice and case-specific writing, then communicates the checked recommendation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Navigating controlled procedure versions and repeating references add clerical work to technical advice.
tasks.enabler_now: Native document metadata and reference headings can remove that limited navigation and formatting.
tasks.still_hard: Procedure suitability depends on the equipment and contamination context.
tasks.human_edge: Identify when standard procedures do not adequately address the actual case.
tasks.altitude: Make the recommendation easier to trace without automating procedure choice.

reach.learn: Preserve context and controlled references in technical advice.

evidence.claim: Controlled document views and reference headings could reduce limited clerical work; procedure choice and savings remain unmeasured.

assumptions: This scenario uses an existing written recommendation read by the work team. It adds no trailing record; oral-only recommendations have no eligible writing baseline.

Qualified measurement personnel produce location, time, value and unit for current contamination measurements. The technician checks equipment identity, size, material and measurement provenance in s1, with all time retained. Document control staff maintain procedure identifiers and versions; absent or incompatible information requires manual investigation.
Native procedure navigation removes 3 hours from the 20-hour lookup step. Reference headings remove only 1.5 hours from the 15-hour recommendation step; technical rationale remains manual.
No automatic procedure selection, generated technical instructions or equipment operation is proposed. Ordinary saves need no self-approval.
unknowns: Whether current controlled metadata allow a useful view.
Whether the recommendation is currently written.
research_questions: Compare current procedure retrieval and reference formatting with native views on several real cases.

already_counted.description: Assess the case and choose the procedure

incremental.description: Maintain procedure view and reference headings

approvals.approved_version: Exact recommendation, equipment scope, procedure versions, restrictions and recipients; changed advice requires checking again before communication.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=95.5, gross 4.5 minus 1 upkeep gives central net 3.5. Conservative case: poorly tagged procedures retain 19.5/20 lookup hours and bespoke references retain 14.5/15 writing hours plus 65 fixed: 99 retained, 1 gross minus 1 =0. Compatible controlled references retain 18 lookup and 14 writing hours plus 65 fixed: 97 retained, 3 gross minus 1 =2.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare reports on contamination tests and decontamination work

steps.what: Collect and reconcile contamination tests, equipment and method records
Assemble report tables from checked test and work records
Draft descriptions of tests, equipment and decontamination methods

loop.purpose: Draft source-grounded descriptions without inventing results or methods
loop.input: Checked source packet and traceable report tables
loop.output: Draft descriptions with source references and explicit gaps
loop.check: The technician checks each described test, equipment item, method and numerical statement against the source records.
loop.stop: One draft and one revision; missing sources, mismatched numbers or uncertain descriptions return that section to manual writing.
loop.why_not_simpler: Tables and headings are deterministic, but work descriptions differ between cases and require checked free-text synthesis.

steps.what: Check reports for technical accuracy, completeness and supported conclusions
Format report tables, headings and source references

tasks.design: Use native {OPS_SYSTEM} report views and deterministic tables in {DOCS}; add a bounded drafting loop only for varied source-grounded descriptions. The technician checks all technical content, and deterministic formatting produces a report draft without sending it or authorising operational action.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manual source collation, table assembly and narrative restatement can repeat the same test and work information.
tasks.enabler_now: Record identifiers and tested report templates support traceable tables, while bounded drafting can propose descriptions for checking.
tasks.still_hard: Incomplete work records or misleading summaries require technical investigation and manual rewriting.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise what the records do and do not demonstrate.
tasks.altitude: Spend report effort on faithful description and interpretation rather than repeated assembly.

reach.learn: Trace every table and narrative assertion to its source.

evidence.claim: LabWare generates analysis certificates with audit trails; this supports structured report generation capability, not a measured saving for nuclear reports.
Benchling AI drafts study reports from laboratory information; suitability for these technical descriptions requires validation.

assumptions: This task prepares the requested report. A distribution or regulatory filing action is not named or assumed, and ordinary author saves are retained within writing/checking time.

Testing technicians produce identified results, units, times and methods in existing test records; decontamination staff produce equipment identifiers, dates and methods in existing work records. S1 includes retrieval and reconciliation of these fields. Missing source records require manual investigation, not invented narrative.
Use native reports and deterministic formatting first. The drafting loop cannot alter test values, decide safety status or invent procedures.
S1 loses 3 hours of repeated navigation only. Table assembly and final formatting have separate priced steps; s5 removes real formatting work, not a same-system save.
unknowns: Whether source records share equipment and test identifiers.
Whether current native reports already produce these tables.
research_questions: Replay reports with missing method records and inconsistent units; measure checking and rewriting as well as drafting time.

already_counted.description: Review drafted descriptions and check the complete report

incremental.description: Maintain report mappings, source-grounding checks and model regression cases

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=60, gross 40 minus 4 upkeep gives central net 36. Conservative case: inconsistent source identifiers retain 19/20 collation hours, table incompatibility retains 16/20 assembly hours, difficult narratives retain 28/30 writing hours and format mismatch retains 3/5 formatting hours, plus 25 technical-check hours: 91 retained, 9 gross minus 4 =5. Compatible sources and report metadata retain 18 collation, 8 table, 20 narrative and 1 formatting hours plus 25 checking: 72 retained, 28 gross minus 4 =24.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Enter nuclear-event characteristics and particle coordinates into computers

steps.what: Collect source event data and reconcile identifiers, units and coordinate frames
Check the exact event-data batch and destination mapping for import
outputs: checked import batch and destination mapping

steps.what: Enter data into the destination computer using the checked import
inputs: checked import batch and destination mapping

steps.what: Verify imported event characteristics and coordinate records against the source batch
Save any manual corrections to existing event records

tasks.design: Use the destination {DATA_PLATFORM}'s native import from existing instrument files in {OPS_SYSTEM}, with explicit field and coordinate-frame mappings. The technician checks the exact source batch and mapping before import, verifies the result and retains manual correction saves.
tasks.previous_blocker: Event values may be manually re-keyed from instrument outputs into a second computer record.
tasks.enabler_now: A native file import can remove that real re-key where the current instruments already produce compatible data.
tasks.still_hard: Wrong identifiers, units or coordinate frames can create plausible but incorrect records.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise source mismatches before data become trusted research records.
tasks.altitude: Move from repeated transcription to checking event-data provenance and mapping.

reach.learn: Tie imported values to exact source versions and coordinate definitions.

evidence.claim: Native file import can remove repeated transcription when instrument data and destination fields are compatible; this design and its time saving are unmeasured.

assumptions: The baseline is actual manual re-key from existing source files into a second computer record, not an ordinary same-system author save. Already imported data have no eligible benefit.

Existing instruments and their current acquisition process produce event identifiers, timestamp, characteristics, coordinate values, units and coordinate-frame metadata. S1 includes technician retrieval and reconciliation. The existing method owner maintains the entry specification. Missing metadata or unsupported formats return the batch to manual entry, not guessed coordinates.
Try the native destination importer before a custom integration. No new detector acquisition, coordinate estimation or safety decision is implied.
The s1 cut removes 5 hours of repeated source navigation and batch preparation; reading and reconciliation remain. S5 retains its small existing save time without self-approval.
unknowns: Whether current source files contain all required coordinate metadata.
Whether destination imports can preserve identifiers and reject duplicates.
research_questions: Replay batches with changed coordinate frames, duplicate identifiers and missing units; compare imported records with checked manual entry.

already_counted.description: Check the import payload and verify destination records

incremental.description: Maintain field mappings and import regression tests

approvals.approved_version: Exact source file version or checksum, event identifiers, values, units, coordinate frame and destination mapping checked in s2; any changed batch or mapping voids the approval.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=50, gross 50 minus 3 upkeep gives central net 47. Conservative case: incomplete output metadata retain 19/20 preparation hours and unsupported fields retain 35/45 transcription hours, plus 35 fixed check/correction hours: 89 retained, 11 gross minus 3 =8. With compatible frames and native import coverage, retain 17 preparation and 11 transcription hours plus 35 fixed: 63 retained, 37 gross minus 3 =34.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep technical judgement and traceable nuclear monitoring records while reducing demonstrated calculation, transcription and report assembly.
reach: Agree source metadata with instrument, laboratory and decontamination personnel.
role.ambitious_version: Reliable analytical and event records with explicit provenance and bounded clerical assistance.
